correctness.inplace: Immutable D2D snapshots before EVERY prime and target; restoration excluded from target event window.
correctness.pipelines: Original stage2 and original per-iteration zeroing retained; training zeros remain INSIDE measured semantic iteration.

decision_rules.control: Report U/G0 and exact-program shams independently. A failed equivalence interval prevents claiming a supported layout gain for that comparison; preserve all results.
decision_rules.layout_gain: For genuine U/G0 suites, both same-round paired 95% CI lower bounds must exceed +3%. All candidates, controls, negative and inconclusive outcomes remain visible.
decision_rules.old_comparison: Old/new cohorts and execution contexts are separate; no paired causal interval or blanket percentage correction is fabricated.
decision_rules.retries: Failed GPU eligibility or source/semantic correction requires a new immutable protocol revision; never copy a later gate into attempt_001. Transport-only redispatches retain failed attempts. No repeated sampling until a desired significance or winner is obtained.

eligibility.gates: Fresh direct finite oracle, exact graph nodes, captured graph oracle before/after. Prior byte-identical three-pattern eligibility is pinned; no recompile.

scope.legacy_boundary: M2/M4 and earlier K-loop/cold-cache or cross-architecture timing remain historical-context evidence; no universal immunity is inferred. This retest does not relabel their numerical values as controlled warm measurements.
scope.not_repeated: Obsolete incorrect-Gluon programs, failed preparations, CPU-only fits, and static/discrete counter evidence are preserved rather than rerun.
scope.preserve: All earlier raw samples, compiler artifacts, NCU files and frozen models/predictions are immutable.
scope.primary: Controlled warm steady-state repeatability and layout comparisons on the complete latest valid matrices.

anchors.baseline_scope: Actual upstream-default explicit Gluon layout plus all legal layouts and independent transfer controls; seen-case remeasurement, never a new blind test.

parent_protocol.authorization: User approved C2d and C3.3, separate commits and push; stop before ten protected D1 GPU compiles/timing.
parent_protocol.technical_reason: Infrastructure only: reuse completed C2c NumPy tools image to avoid stalled package mirror. No C2d function dispatched and no GPU allocated; case matrix and measurement method unchanged.

c2d.scope: Seen-case natural FULL/T_control remeasurement. No source-aligned U/G0 identity or new blind result is claimed.

parent_protocol.authorization: User explicitly approved CPU protocol binding then all ten D1 H100 shapes, validator, commit and push; stop for review.
parent_protocol.coverage: Frozen precompile predictions only; no conditioning on measured n_regs/q; all eligible FULL layouts and nondefault pairs, stratified.

development_only_primary_selection.scope: Nine outer CV geometries used to select primary; not independent confirmation.

endpoint.auxiliary: 128 MiB raw event time, us, reported separately
endpoint.case_aggregate: median of three worker-paired gain/regret ratios
endpoint.primary: natural-q loop-free FULL 128/256/384 MiB time-versus-grid/SM OLS slope, ns/tile/SM

parent_protocol.failure_policy: Keep all artifacts and spills. Executable spills timed. Unavailable candidates and frozen selections are reported as failures without substitution.

retry_policy.budget_error: stop and report; do not switch profiles

d1.scope: Seen-case natural FULL/T_control remeasurement. No source-aligned U/G0 identity or new blind result is claimed.

legacy.baseline_scope: Explicit Gluon N-first placement reference; no authentic Triton U/G0 pair is invented.

parent_protocol.authorization: User approved additional GPU hypothesis generation and verification after M2.
